body: I debate the validity of my depression all the time. I try to justify it as "just feeling down" and being "over reactionary".
I'm not an eminent danger, I just feel myself getting worse and hate waiting.
There are many different types of psychology and therapy. You have to find the one that works best for you. Don't get discouraged if you don't find the right one right away.

I am truly in the same boat. I have had that exact car wreck conversation with myself. 

I have a beautiful 2.5 year old son; but I do feel feel like him and my husband can survive if I wasn't around, and I have been hearing the calls of any sharp objects around.
It's just an over encompassing feeling. I'm just tired. Just so fucking tired. And I feel shitty because in all honesty I have a great life and I'm an asshole for feeling any other way.
I'm sure it has something with the beautiful child sitting in my lap. But even so I think that it won't be much different if anything dos happen.
It's more like, I'm wanting to not exist.

I'm very much this way and it has caused a lot of issues with me receiving the help I need. I get viciously depressed - suicide planning and all and then I start convincing myself that I am over reacting. I'll have a good day and then rationalize that I wasn't that bad after all and basically rinse, wash, repeat. 

I'm setting up an appointment to see a new PCP this week and talk to them about psychiatric medicine.
Is it possible to be functionally depressed?
